029/**
030 * A lightweight MIME type detector that doesn't require Jakarta Activation.
031 *
032 * <p>
033 * This class provides MIME type detection using multiple strategies:
034 * <ol>
035 *   <li>Java NIO's {@link Files#probeContentType(Path)} for content-based detection
036 *   <li>Extension-based mapping for common file types
037 *   <li>Configurable MIME type mappings
038 * </ol>
039 *
040 * <p>
041 * This class is thread-safe and can be used as a drop-in replacement for
042 * <c>javax.activation.MimetypesFileTypeMap</c> without requiring Jakarta Activation.
043 *
044 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
045 * <p class='bjava'>
046 *    <jc>// Basic usage</jc>
047 *    MimeTypeDetector <jv>detector</jv> = MimeTypeDetector.builder().build();
048 *    String <jv>mimeType</jv> = <jv>detector</jv>.getContentType(<js>"document.pdf"</js>);
049 *    <jc>// mimeType = "application/pdf"</jc>
050 *
051 *    <jc>// Custom configuration</jc>
052 *    MimeTypeDetector <jv>custom</jv> = MimeTypeDetector.builder()
053 *       .addExtensionType(<js>"custom"</js>, <js>"application/x-custom"</js>)
054 *       .addTypes(<js>"application/x-foo:foo,bar"</js>)
055 *       .setCacheSize(500)
056 *       .build();
057 * </p>
058 *
059 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
060 *    <li class='jm'>{@link Files#probeContentType(Path)}
061 *    <li class='jm'><c>javax.activation.MimetypesFileTypeMap</c> (legacy class, not available in Java 11+)
062 * </ul>
063 */
064@SuppressWarnings({
065   "java:S1192" // Duplicated literals (argument/property names) read more clearly inline than as constants
066})
067public class MimeTypeDetector {
068
069   /**
070    * Builder class for creating MimeTypeDetector instances.
071    */
072   public static class Builder {
073
074      private final Map<String,String> extMap = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
075      private final Map<String,String> fileMap = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
076      private boolean nioContentBasedDetection = true;
077      private int cacheSize = 1000;
078      private CacheMode cacheMode = FULL;
079      private boolean cacheLogOnExit = false;
080      private String defaultType = "application/octet-stream";
081
082      /**
083       * Adds the default MIME type mappings.
084       *
085       * @return This builder.
086       */
087      public Builder addDefaultMappings() {
088         return addTypes("application/epub+zip epub", "application/java-archive jar", "application/javascript js", "application/json json", "application/msword doc", "application/ogg ogx",
089            "application/pdf pdf", "application/rtf rtf", "application/vnd.amazon.ebook azw", "application/vnd.apple.installer+xml mpkg", "application/vnd.mozilla.xul+xml xul",
090            "application/vnd.ms-excel xls", "application/vnd.ms-powerpoint ppt", "application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.presentation odp", "application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet ods",
091            "application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.text odt", "application/vnd.visio vsd", "application/x-7z-compressed 7z", "application/x-abiword abw", "application/x-bzip bz",
092            "application/x-bzip2 bz2", "application/x-csh csh", "application/x-rar-compressed rar", "application/x-sh sh", "application/x-shockwave-flash swf", "application/x-tar tar",
093            "application/xhtml+xml xhtml", "application/xml xml", "application/zip zip", "audio/aac aac", "audio/midi mid midi", "audio/ogg oga", "audio/webm weba", "audio/x-wav wav",
094            "font/ttf ttf", "font/woff woff", "font/woff2 woff2", "image/gif gif", "image/jpeg jpeg jpg", "image/png png", "image/svg+xml svg", "image/tiff tif tiff", "image/webp webp",
095            "image/x-icon ico", "text/calendar ics", "text/css css", "text/csv csv", "text/html htm html", "text/plain txt", "video/3gpp 3gp", "video/3gpp2 3g2", "video/mpeg mpeg",
096            "video/ogg ogv", "video/webm webm", "video/x-msvideo avi");
097      }
098
099      /**
100       * Adds an extension type mapping.
101       *
102       * @param ext The file extension.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
103       * @param type The MIME type.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
104       * @return This builder.
105       * @throws IllegalArgumentException If ext or type is null or blank.
106       */
107      public Builder addExtensionType(String ext, String type) {
108         reqnb("ext", ext);
109         reqnb("type", type);
110         extMap.put(lcr(ext), type);
111         return this;
112      }
113
114      /**
115       * Adds a file type mapping.
116       *
117       * @param name The file name or path pattern.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
118       * @param type The MIME type.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
119       * @return This builder.
120       * @throws IllegalArgumentException If name or type is null or blank.
121       */
122      public Builder addFileType(String name, String type) {
123         reqnb("name", name);
124         reqnb("type", type);
125         fileMap.put(name, type);
126         return this;
127      }
128
129      /**
130       * Enables NIO content-based detection.
131       *
132       * <p>
133       * Zero-arg form of {@link #addNioContentBasedDetection(boolean)}, consistent with the other
134       * zero-arg builder toggles in the <c>io</c> package (e.g. {@link FileWriterBuilder#buffered()}).
135       *
136       * @return This builder.
137       */
138      public Builder addNioContentBasedDetection() {
139         return addNioContentBasedDetection(true);
140      }
141
142      /**
143       * Enables or disables NIO content-based detection.
144       *
145       * @param value Whether to enable NIO content-based detection.
146       * @return This builder.
147       */
148      public Builder addNioContentBasedDetection(boolean value) {
149         nioContentBasedDetection = value;
150         return this;
151      }
152
153      /**
154       * Adds MIME type mappings from mime.types file format.
155       *
156       * <p>
157       * Each line should follow the format:
158       * <pre>
159       * text/html        html htm
160       * image/png        png
161       * application/json json
162       * </pre>
163       *
164       * <p>
165       * This method supports both individual lines as varargs and entire
166       * mime.types file contents as a single string (which will be split on newlines).
167       *
168       * @param mimeTypesLines The MIME types lines or file contents.  Null and empty entries are ignored.
169       * @return This builder.
170       */
171      @SuppressWarnings({
172         "java:S3776" // Cognitive complexity acceptable for MIME type parsing
173      })
174      public Builder addTypes(String...mimeTypesLines) {
175         for (var input : mimeTypesLines) {
176            if (ine(input)) {
177               // Split on newlines to handle both individual lines and file contents
178               var lines = input.split("\\r?\\n");
179               for (var line : lines) {
180                  if (ine(line) && ! line.trim().startsWith("#")) {
181                     var parts = line.trim().split("\\s+");
182                     if (parts.length >= 2) {
183                        var mimeType = parts[0];
184                        for (var i = 1; i < parts.length; i++) {
185                           addExtensionType(parts[i], mimeType);
186                        }
187                     }
188                  }
189               }
190            }
191         }
192         return this;
193      }
194
195      /**
196       * Builds the MimeTypeDetector instance.
197       *
198       * @return A new MimeTypeDetector instance.
199       */
200      public MimeTypeDetector build() {
201         return new MimeTypeDetector(this);
202      }
203
204      /**
205       * Enables cache logging on exit.
206       *
207       * <p>
208       * Zero-arg form of {@link #setCacheLogOnExit(boolean)}, consistent with the other zero-arg
209       * builder toggles in the <c>io</c> package (e.g. {@link FileWriterBuilder#buffered()}).
210       *
211       * @return This builder.
212       */
213      public Builder setCacheLogOnExit() {
214         return setCacheLogOnExit(true);
215      }
216
217      /**
218       * Enables or disables cache logging on exit.
219       *
220       * @param value Whether to log cache statistics on exit.
221       * @return This builder.
222       */
223      public Builder setCacheLogOnExit(boolean value) {
224         cacheLogOnExit = value;
225         return this;
226      }
227
228      /**
229       * Sets the caching mode for MIME type lookups.
230       *
231       * <p>
232       * Available modes:
233       * <ul>
234       *    <li>{@link CacheMode#NONE NONE} - No caching (always recompute)
235       *    <li>{@link CacheMode#WEAK WEAK} - Weak caching (uses {@link WeakHashMap})
236       *    <li>{@link CacheMode#FULL FULL} - Full caching (uses {@link ConcurrentHashMap}, default)
237       * </ul>
238       *
239       * @param value The caching mode.
240       * @return This builder.
241       */
242      public Builder setCacheMode(CacheMode value) {
243         cacheMode = value;
244         return this;
245      }
246
247      /**
248       * Sets the cache size.
249       *
250       * @param value The maximum cache size.
251       * @return This builder.
252       */
253      public Builder setCacheSize(int value) {
254         cacheSize = value;
255         return this;
256      }
257
258      /**
259       * Sets the default MIME type for unknown files.
260       *
261       * @param value The default MIME type.
262       * @return This builder.
263       */
264      public Builder setDefaultType(String value) {
265         defaultType = value;
266         return this;
267      }
268   }
269
270   /**
271    * Default MIME type detector instance.
272    */
273   public static final MimeTypeDetector DEFAULT = builder().addDefaultMappings().build();
274
275   /**
276    * Creates a new builder for MimeTypeDetector.
277    *
278    * @return A new builder.
279    */
280   public static Builder builder() {
281      return new Builder();
282   }
283
284   private final Map<String,String> extMap;
285   private final Map<String,String> fileMap;
286   private final Cache<String,String> cache;
287   private final boolean nioContentBasedDetection;
288   private final String defaultType;
289
290   /**
291    * Constructor.
292    *
293    * @param builder The builder.
294    */
295   private MimeTypeDetector(Builder builder) {
296      this.extMap = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(builder.extMap);
297      this.fileMap = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(builder.fileMap);
298      this.nioContentBasedDetection = builder.nioContentBasedDetection;
299      this.defaultType = builder.defaultType;
300
301      // Create cache for file-based lookups
302      var cacheBuilder = Cache.of(String.class, String.class).maxSize(builder.cacheSize).cacheMode(builder.cacheMode);
303
304      if (builder.cacheLogOnExit) {
305         cacheBuilder.logOnExit("MimeTypeDetector");
306      }
307
308      this.cache = cacheBuilder.build();
309   }
310
311   /**
312    * Clears the MIME type cache.
313    *
314    * <p>
315    * This method can be called to free memory or when you want to ensure
316    * fresh MIME type detection (e.g., after files have been modified).
317    */
318   public void clearCache() {
319      cache.clear();
320   }
321
322   /**
323    * Returns the number of cache hits since the cache was created.
324    *
325    * @return The number of cache hits.
326    */
327   public int getCacheHits() { return cache.getCacheHits(); }
328
329   /**
330    * Returns the current cache size.
331    *
332    * @return The number of cached MIME type entries.
333    */
334   public int getCacheSize() { return cache.size(); }
335
336   /**
337    * Determines the MIME type of a file based on its name or path.
338    *
339    * <p>
340    * This method uses multiple strategies to determine the MIME type:
341    * <ol>
342    *   <li>Checks cache first for previously determined MIME types
343    *   <li>If the file exists, uses {@link Files#probeContentType(Path)} for content-based detection
344    *   <li>Falls back to extension-based mapping for common file types
345    *   <li>Returns the configured default type for unknown types
346    * </ol>
347    *
348    * <p>
349    * Results are cached to improve performance for repeated lookups of the same files.
350    *
351    * @param fileName The name or path of the file.  Can be <jk>null</jk> or empty, in which case the default type is returned.
352    * @return The MIME type of the file, or the default type if unknown.
353    */
354   public String getContentType(String fileName) {
355      if (ie(fileName)) {
356         return defaultType;
357      }
358
359      // Check file map first (for specific file mappings)
360      var fileMimeType = fileMap.get(fileName);
361      if (nn(fileMimeType)) {
362         return fileMimeType;
363      }
364
365      // Use cache with supplier for automatic cache management
366      return cache.get(fileName, () -> determineMimeType(fileName));
367   }
368
369   /**
370    * Determines the MIME type without caching (internal method).
371    *
372    * @param fileName The name or path of the file.
373    * @return The MIME type of the file.
374    */
375   private String determineMimeType(String fileName) {
376      // Try Java NIO's content-based detection first
377      if (nioContentBasedDetection) {
378         try {
379            var path = Paths.get(fileName);
380            if (Files.exists(path)) {
381               var contentType = Files.probeContentType(path);
382               if (ine(contentType)) {
383                  return contentType;
384               }
385         }
386         } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") Exception e) {
387         // Fall back to extension-based detection
388         }
389      }
390
391      // Fall back to extension-based detection
392      var extension = getFileExtension(fileName);
393      if (ine(extension)) {
394         var mimeType = extMap.get(lcr(extension));
395         if (nn(mimeType)) {
396            return mimeType;
397         }
398      }
399
400      // Default fallback
401      return defaultType;
402   }
403}
